title: Restrictions on Smoking and Unregulated Nicotine Products
canonicalText:
[[GA.8048 | Restrictions on Smoking and Unregulated Nicotine Products | Applies to: Administrative | Revised 12/31/2024]]
<<page 1>>
I. PURPOSE
This policy establishes and defines CalOptima Health’s restrictions on Smoking and use of Unregulated
Nicotine Products in, or on, Property owned, operated, or leased by CalOptima Health, unless otherwise
specified.
II. POLICY
A. As a public agency providing access to quality health care services, CalOptima Health endeavors to
  maintain a safe and healthful environment for its Employees, Members, and visitors of CalOptima
  Health Properties. Therefore, Smoking, inclusive of electronic Smoking devices, and the use of
  Unregulated Nicotine Products are strictly prohibited inside and outside of CalOptima Health
  Property, except in designated outside Smoking areas at least twenty-five (25) feet away from
  buildings. The PACE center does not allow smoking or the use of Unregulated Nicotine Products
  anywhere on the property. This Policy is effective from Monday through Sunday, twenty-four (24)
  hours per day.
B. CalOptima Health Property, as used herein, includes any Properties owned, operated, or leased by
  CalOptima Health, including the administration building at 505 City Parkway West, in the City of
  Orange, State of California, 500 City Parkway West, in the City of Orange, State of California, and
  the PACE building at 13300 Garden Grove Boulevard, in the City of Garden Grove, State of
  California, and including CalOptima Health-owned, or leased, vehicles.
C. All CalOptima Health Employees shall adhere to this policy and include, but are not limited to, all
  full-time and part-time regular CalOptima Health Employees, all temporary Employees,
  interns/volunteers, CalOptima Health Board Members, advisory and standing committee members,
  and authorized contractors and consultants. Failure to follow this policy may result in progressive
  disciplinary action, or termination.
D. Smoking includes carrying or holding of any lighted pipe, cigar, or cigarettes of any kind, including
  electronic Smoking devices (e.g., e-cigarettes and/or vaporizers), any lighted Smoking equipment,
  or the lighting, inhaling, or exhaling of smoke from a pipe, cigar, or cigarette of any kind, including
  e-cigarettes and vaporizers.
<<page 2>>
E. Smoking and the use of unregulated nicotine only within the designated Smoking area, located at
  least twenty-five (25) feet away from the CalOptima Health Property buildings, except for the
  PACE Center property, shall be strictly enforced by all CalOptima Health Employees.
F. CalOptima Health’s Property Manager shall be responsible for posting appropriate signage in key
  areas in and around CalOptima Health Property, in addition, but not limited to, entrances, exits, and
  parking lot.
  1. Adjacent public thoroughfares, sidewalks, and parking lots not owned by CalOptima Health are
    subject to local jurisdiction such as regulations governing Smoking proximate to building
    entrances, exits, ventilation intakes, and open windows.
  2. The Facilities Director shall request that the Property Manager accommodate the terms of this
    policy as it might apply to common areas shared by non-CalOptima Health entities.
G. CalOptima Health Employees who smoke, use an electronic Smoking device, or use Unregulated
  Nicotine Products in, or on, CalOptima Health Property (excluding the PACE Center property)
  outside of the designated Smoking area(s) are in violation of this policy and shall be subject to
  corrective measures, including discipline, in accordance with CalOptima Health Policy GA.8022:
  Performance and Behavior Standards.
III. PROCEDURE
Responsible Party   Action
Employee   1. Adhere to the requirements in this policy.
Manager   1. Interpret and enforce this policy in their area of responsibility.
2. If a CalOptima Health Employee disregards and/or violates this policy,
the Manager will address the Employee immediately.
Human Resources   1. Provide CalOptima Health Employees with CalOptima Health Policy
GA.8048: Restrictions on Smoking and Unregulated Nicotine Products.
Property Manager   1. The Property Manager will enforce CalOptima Health’s restrictions on
Smoking and unregulated nicotine product policy as directed by the
CalOptima Health Facilities Director.
Facilities Director   1. Ensure the Property Manager adheres to the provisions of this policy.
V. REFERENCES
A. CalOptima Health Employee Handbook
B. CalOptima Health Policy GA.8022: Performance and Behavior Standards
C. California Labor Code, §6404.5
D. Title 32, California Code of Regulations (C.C.R.), §§7596-7597
<<page 4>>
IX. GLOSSARY
CalOptima Health Employees: For purposes of this policy include, but are not limited to, all full-time and part-time regular CalOptima Health Employees, all temporary Employees, interns/volunteers, CalOptima Health Board Members, advisory and Standing Committee Members and authorized contractors and consultants.
CalOptima Health Property: Any property owned, operated or leased by CalOptima Health, including CalOptima Health owned or leased vehicles, the administration building at 505 City Parkway West, in the City of Orange, State of California, 500 City Parkway West, in the City of Orange, State of California, the PACE building at 13300 Garden Grove Boulevard, in the City of Garden Grove, State of California, and the CalOptima Health satellite office located at the County Community Service Center, 15496 Magnolia Street, Suite 111, in the City of Westminster, State of California. CalOptima Health Property shall include surrounding ground and parking lots owned, operated, or leased by CalOptima Health, as well as other leased or rented spaces.
Facilities Director: For purposes of this policy ensures upkeep, maintenance, CalOptima Health Employee safety, building rules and regulations are adhered to in conjunction with the Property Manager.
Member: A beneficiary who is enrolled in a CalOptima Health Program.
Property Manager: An outside fee-based Property management company, with experience at managing high rise office buildings
Smoking: For purposes of this policy, the carrying or holding of any lighted pipe, cigar, or cigarettes of any kind, including electronic Smoking devices (e.g., e-cigarettes and/or vaporizers), any lighted Smoking equipment, or the lighting, inhaling, or exhaling of smoke from a pipe, cigar, or cigarette of any kind, including e-cigarettes and vaporizers.
Unregulated Nicotine Product: Any product containing, or delivering, nicotine intended, or expected, for human consumption, or any part of such a product, that has not been approved, or otherwise certified, for sale by the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) as a tobacco use cessation product, or for other medical purposes.
